entries.subject: DAMIT 3722: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-3722.txt. Model 3722, version 2019-05-07, pole (125°, 62°), period 11.82586 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: The retained calibration uses 25.458 ±0.591 km. effective body diameter

entries.subject: Other DAMIT shape solutions
entries.finding: The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 3723: pole (312°, 30°), 11.82584 h, version 2019-05-07. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: Independent shape, spin or scale evidence distinguishes these alternatives, or a changed release offers a demonstrably better supported model.
